'''Justin Stauffer''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 63 in the Corellia region, from Indianapolis, Indiana.<ref name="decsq-corellia" /> His slot was later marked Retired.<ref name="sm-fan" /> At DecipherCon 1999 he also played [[Young Jedi]], finishing second in the YJ Gauntlet and fifth in The Gauntlet Dual Formats.<ref name="dc99yj30_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ30_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: The Gauntlet Dual Formats], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001119215300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ30_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj30_3">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ30_3.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Gauntlet], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010105011900/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ30_3.html Internet Archive]</ref>
